title: Inspect library PCA outputs
description: You display projected coordinates and their explained variance ratios when the library is available.

steps.description: You guard the library branch with SKLEARN_AVAILABLE. When it passes, fit_transform creates two projected coordinates per row and evr stores their variance fractions.
You scatter the first two projected columns. The axes identify PC1 and PC2.

steps.question: What values set the two bar heights in the next figure?
steps.answer: evr[:2] supplies the explained variance ratios. The horizontal positions are component numbers one and two.

steps.description: You display the variance-ratio bars when the library branch runs. Otherwise, the code prints its skip message; the supplied recording contains no printed numeric ratios.
